+
+
+def _gate_up_weight_arguments(shared_fc1: torch.Tensor, routed_fc1, intermediate_size: int):
+    """Adapt MCore-owned combined FC1 weights to MOK's gate/up API.
+
+    Shared FC1 is a dense two-dimensional parameter, so gate and up are
+    ordinary zero-copy row views. Routed FC1 may span multiple experts or
+    descriptor-backed allocations; passing the same combined payload for gate
+    and up preserves its storage metadata, and MOK applies the existing logical
+    gate/up offsets when the two arguments alias.
+    """
+    expected_rows = 2 * intermediate_size
+    if shared_fc1.ndim != 2 or shared_fc1.shape[0] != expected_rows:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "MOK shared FC1 shape mismatch: "
+            f"got {tuple(shared_fc1.shape)}, expected [{expected_rows}, hidden_size]"
+        )
+    shared_gate = shared_fc1.narrow(0, 0, intermediate_size)
+    shared_up = shared_fc1.narrow(0, intermediate_size, intermediate_size)
+    return shared_gate, shared_up, routed_fc1, routed_fc1
+
+
+def _gate_up_main_grad_arguments(main_grads, main_grad_storage_tables, intermediate_size: int):
+    """Adapt canonical FC1/FC2 main-grad buffers to MOK's six-buffer order."""
+    shared_fc1, routed_fc1, shared_fc2, routed_fc2 = main_grads
+    shared_gate, shared_up, routed_gate, routed_up = _gate_up_weight_arguments(
+        shared_fc1, routed_fc1, intermediate_size
+    )
+    split_main_grads = (shared_gate, routed_gate, shared_up, routed_up, shared_fc2, routed_fc2)
+    if main_grad_storage_tables is None:
+        return split_main_grads, None
+    routed_fc1_table, routed_fc2_table = main_grad_storage_tables
+    return split_main_grads, (routed_fc1_table, routed_fc1_table, routed_fc2_table)
+
+
+class _MoKAutograd(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Autograd bridge from MCore parameters to MoK's functional API."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(
+        ctx,
+        module: "MoKMegakernel",
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        router_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        top_experts: torch.Tensor,
+        shared_output_gate_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+        *parameters: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run MOK forward and retain the state needed by backward."""
+        from mok import functional
+
+        num_routed_parameters = len(module.autograd_routed_parameters)
+        if len(parameters) != num_routed_parameters + 2:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "MOK autograd parameter count mismatch: "
+                f"got {len(parameters)}, expected {num_routed_parameters + 2}"
+            )
+        routed_parameters = parameters[:num_routed_parameters]
+        shared_fc1, shared_fc2 = parameters[num_routed_parameters:]
+        workspace = functional.get_workspace(
+            module.mok_config,
+            module.ep_group,
+            device=x.device,
+            num_local_tokens=x.shape[0],
+            hidden_size=x.shape[1],
+            topk=top_experts.shape[1],
+        )
+        schedule = functional.build_schedule(
+            workspace, module.mok_config, top_experts, num_local_experts=module.num_local_experts
+        )
+        fc1_weight_view, fc2_weight_view = module.quantized_routed_weights()
+        if module.use_mxfp8_weights and module.native_single_grouped_weights:
+            # Single-weight MXFP8 forward consumes only rowwise data and scale.

+            fc2_forward = fc2_weight_view[:2]
+        else:
+            # Single-weight BF16 has no separate rowwise/columnwise physical tuple.
+            # Non-single BF16/MXFP8 use SplitRoutedWeight objects consumed directly by MOK.
+            fc1_forward = fc1_weight_view
+            fc2_forward = fc2_weight_view
+        shared_gate, shared_up, routed_gate, routed_up = _gate_up_weight_arguments(
+            shared_fc1, fc1_forward, module.intermediate_size
+        )

## Reject unsupported FP64 routing during MOK configuration

An otherwise-supported BF16 MOK setup—for example, hidden/intermediate size 256, 512 local tokens, and two experts/top-k two—with `moe_router_dtype="fp64"` and `moe_router_fusion=False` passes configuration validation but fails on its first forward. [Router.gating](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/megatron/core/transformer/moe/router.py#L141-L147) produces double logits, [routing preserves that dtype](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_utils.py#L1034-L1055), and the new [route adapter](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/megatron/core/transformer/moe/megakernel/mok/route_adapter.py#L116-L121) raises `TypeError`.

Until MOK supports FP64 weighted averaging, reject this combination explicitly during configuration rather than after distributed model construction. Inside the existing MOK-only block in [TransformerConfig.__post_init__](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/megatron/core/transformer/transformer_config.py#L2609-L2623), add:

```python
if self.moe_router_dtype == "fp64":
    raise ValueError("MOK does not support moe_router_dtype='fp64'; use 'fp32' instead")
```

Also document the restriction in the [MOK support table](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/megatron/core/transformer/moe/README.md#L625-L636). Do not simply remove the converter's dtype check: it produces FP32 weights, whereas the [router option](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/megatron/core/transformer/transformer_config.py#L998-L1001) also controls weighted-averaging precision.

**Acceptance and preservation:** Add configuration cases to [the MOK configuration tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/0c6cf7bd83aecacd3c1fb08fc82355a1d209bf6c/tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/test_mok_weights.py#L98-L131): MOK plus `"fp64"` must raise the explicit error; MOK with `None` or `"fp32"` and native MoE with `"fp64"` must remain accepted. Retain the converter's existing exact FP16/BF16/FP32 forward/backward checks, including missing-route padding.

This patch and the proposed checks are source-reasoned, not executed; verify before adopting. Static light review covered all changed files and affected interfaces. Tests/builds were not run, and the external pinned MOK implementation was unavailable for independent inspection.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.
